errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the main grouping factor of the chart, which is "Възможност за избор на работно място" (Possibility to choose a workplace), indicated by the chart's title and the group labels "НЕ" (NO) and "ДА" (YES).

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, които са "От вкъщи" и "От офиса"
errors.evidence: The chart is split into two distinct panels based on the possibility of choice ("НЕ" and "ДА"). The description incorrectly treats the chart as having a single horizontal axis with two categories, completely missing this fundamental two-part structure.
The description claims the categories are in a random order, which is an unsubstantiated interpretation. The order ("От вкъщи", then "От офиса") is consistent in both panels.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са оцветени в зелено за работа от вкъщи и в синьо за работа от офис.
errors.evidence: The colors do not represent the work location. Green bars represent the group with no choice of workplace ("НЕ"), and blue bars represent the group with a choice of workplace ("ДА").

errors.text_span: докато за работа от офис е около 34
errors.evidence: This value is incorrect. There are two bars for "работа от офис" (work from office), one at approximately 24 (in the "НЕ" group) and one at approximately 41 (in the "ДА" group). The value 34 does not correspond to any bar for this category.

errors.text_span: Стойността на мотивацията за работа от вкъщи е приблизително 18, докато за работа от офис е около 34.
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately collapses four distinct data points into two. It mentions only one value for "работа от вкъщи" (~18) while ignoring the other (~35), and presents an incorrect summary value for "работа от офис", thus misrepresenting the core comparisons shown in the chart.

errors.text_span: Нивото на мотивация за работа от офиса е по-високо от това за работа от вкъщи
errors.evidence: This statement is a misleading oversimplification. While it holds true within each group (choice vs. no choice), it is not true across groups. For example, motivation for working from home with a choice (~35) is significantly higher than working from the office without a choice (~24).
